name: DisplayFusion
sources: https://www.displayfusion.com/Help/ (Settings > Functions and Settings > Alt+Tab sections)
note: Checked against DisplayFusion v12.1.1 (current as of this writing). Binary Fortress's own 'Default Keyboard Shortcuts' help page lists exactly six built-in Functions that ship with a default hotkey; those are the six actions below. DisplayFusion has hundreds of other Functions (including monitor, window, wallpaper, and 'Toggle Key Combinations' functions), but none of the rest have a default key assigned - they are inert until a user binds them on the Settings > Functions tab, so per the catalog rule they are not included as shortcuts. This profile also matches DisplayFusion's Alt+Tab replacement window (window class DFAltTabWindow:..., empty title, owned by DisplayFusion.exe), but no 'Alt+Tab handler' context actions or Tune defaults are included: the Help page and the Alt+Tab Handler feature page both document only its Settings > Alt+Tab configuration (which monitor(s) it shows on, whether it shows all/current windows, thumbnail size, titles/icons/close button) and say nothing about which keys operate the popup itself (arrow keys, Tab, Enter, Esc, or type-to-filter), and no Binary Fortress forum post could be found confirming those keys either. The Tune defaults assume the Alt+Tab handler takes the same keys as the stock Windows switcher (arrows, Enter, Esc); Binary Fortress does not document them, so confirm on a machine with DisplayFusion. This profile is active while DisplayFusion.exe is in the foreground, which in practice means its Alt+Tab handler (observed 2026-09-05 as window class DFAltTabWindow with an empty title).
